decisive_items: enlargement of the right sphenoid sinus with overdevelopment and opacity of the lateral recess
purulent discharge in the sphenoethmoidal recess
intracranial extension into the cavernous sinus surrounded the Gasserian ganglion
response.rationale: The champion candidate R1 (Sphenoid sinusitis) is supported by multiple raw spans indicating sinusitis symptoms and imaging findings, while the runner-up candidate C1 (Sphenoid sinusitis with intracranial extension) is a more specific diagnosis that is also well-supported by the text. The decisive items highlight the key evidence for these diagnoses.

rejected.why: treatment for presumed trigeminal neuralgia was ineffective
histopathology was negative for neoplastic cells
